== frame after_pwd cursor=4,27
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cd ~/subdir
|testuser@<HOST> ~/subdir $ pwd
|<HOME>/subdir
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~/subdir $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cd
@1 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~/subdir
@1 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 pwd
@4 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~/subdir
